description.zh: 原生多网卡出口路由切换与跃点数管理工具：支持查看 IPv4/IPv6 默认出口、调整首选/备选网卡优先级、自定义跃点数、出口测速及系统托盘快捷切换。
description.en: Native multi-NIC egress route switcher and interface metric manager: inspect IPv4/IPv6 default gateways, prioritize primary/secondary adapters, set custom metrics, test egress latency, and switch quickly via system tray.

description.zh: 查看并切换 IPv4/IPv6 默认出口网卡，调整跃点数或进行连通性测速
description.en: Inspect and switch default IPv4/IPv6 egress adapters, adjust metrics, or test connectivity

hint.zh: 输入网卡名称、IP 或关键词筛选；Enter 执行选中操作，Shift+Enter 打开管理界面
hint.en: Type adapter name, IP, or keyword to filter; Enter runs selected action, Shift+Enter opens panel

title.zh: 同步调整 IPv6 接口跃点数

hint.zh: 设为主/备选出口或恢复自动跃点数时，同步更新该网卡的 IPv6 跃点优先级
hint.en: Update IPv6 interface metrics alongside IPv4 when prioritizing or restoring automatic metrics

title.zh: 显示未连接的网络适配器

hint.zh: 在列表与管理界面中显示当前断开连接或已禁用的物理/虚拟网卡
hint.en: Display disconnected or disabled adapters in search results and the management window
